title: Where distinctive value is likely to be found.
lede: Six categories under active study, not committed investments. Each is a candidate for the same treatment: identify what is genuinely distinctive, shape it properly, and carry it out under its own name.

exploring.label: Exploring
exploring.description: Thesis work — reading the category, meeting operators, and testing whether the opportunity is real.

developing.label: In development
developing.description: Concept and operating model under construction. Not yet trading.

selective.label: Selective
selective.description: Engaging with a small number of specific opportunities rather than the category at large.

active.label: Active interest
active.description: Live conversations and structures in progress. Still not an operating business until it says so plainly.

items.title: Jewellery & Gemstones
items.description: Ceylon sapphire and fine stones, traced from source to setting and sold on provenance rather than volume.

items.title: Curated Travel & Hospitality
items.description: Small-footprint stays built around a genuine sense of place, with an operating standard that survives a second visit.

items.title: Export-Ready Ceylon Products
items.description: Categories the island already produces well, brought to market under a name it owns rather than a private label.

items.title: Heritage Craft & Design
items.description: Traditional making — textile, ceramic, timber — reintroduced through contemporary design and direct relationships with buyers.

items.title: Digital Experiences
items.description: Specialist technical and creative teams, priced on outcome rather than headcount, for clients in mature markets.

items.title: Cross-Border Trade Opportunities
items.description: Structures that move credible operators in both directions — into Sri Lanka, and out of it — with one party accountable for the outcome.
